claim: Human/CLI task path, acceptance: `kta task create T3` writes a TaskCard and queues it; `kta task submit --check` leases with a budget reservation in scope global (agent_min 600), starts, submits (Submission with the file as blob), runs the T3 done-checks (delivery_note, validate_template: PASS), writes the Template into the pool (actor.task = the task), a task_result Report and a done_checks Report, and settles the reservation (reserved back to 0)
command: kta budget global --set agent_min=600; kta task create T3 ...; kta task submit <id> --dir t3-good --check; kta budget global
notes: The submitted Template is a renamed copy of seed async_transfer, used only to exercise the path; it is not new knowledge

command: kta task create T3 ...; kta task submit <id> --dir t3-bad --check (twice); kta task cancel <id> --reason ...
